notes.title: Variety in the Passenger Jobs
notes.content: Added a bit of variety in the passenger job to avoid making tasks repetitive.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content: Added few more elements to the Open world and resolved some UI bugs.

notes.title: Minor menu bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where mouse cursor would not show up on the menu if connected to a controller/save game was corrupted.

notes.title: Improvements to UI and controls
notes.content:
Added a few UI elements and controls in order to make it easier for a fresh player to identify the controls and key bindings. 
Added a photo mode. 
Sneak peek into the areas that will be newly added with the next patch.
